title: Media Buy Status
description: Status of a media buy. Status is the buyer-actionable readiness axis; seller commitment is the independent `confirmed_at` field. A buy with `confirmed_at: null` is never `active`.

enumDescriptions.pending_creatives: **Buyer-side action required.** No package can begin delivery because required creative coverage is missing or a blocking rejection requires correction or replacement. A rejected assignment does not block an otherwise eligible approved subset when start_requires_all_creatives_approved is false. Seller review of already assigned creatives alone is pending_start, not pending_creatives. Seller commitment is the independent confirmed_at axis; neither pending status means the seller has accepted the buy.
enumDescriptions.pending_start: The buy has not started and is waiting for its flight date, seller confirmation (confirmed_at: null), or seller review of already assigned creatives needed for delivery. This includes the initial package gate start_requires_all_creatives_approved: true while all required assignments await approval. Review completion may allow automatic start only when commitment, flight, pause, and creative-readiness conditions permit it; rejection may instead require buyer correction and pending_creatives. Inspect package creative_approvals and, for library sellers, list_creatives for review state. A provisional buy never becomes active until the seller commits.
enumDescriptions.active: Media buy is currently running. Reported only for a committed buy: a buy whose `confirmed_at` is null MUST NOT be `active`.
enumDescriptions.rejected: Media buy was declined by the seller after creation
enumDescriptions.canceled: Media buy was terminated before natural completion. Check cancellation.canceled_by to determine whether the buyer or seller initiated.
